counting_semantics.active_customer_count: N is the number of distinct selected delivery-site IDs in an instance; each selected house or apartment site contributes exactly one
counting_semantics.cle_customer_pool: distinct identifiable potential residential delivery sites in the city; one independent house contributes one site and one identified apartment complex contributes one site
counting_semantics.coverage: CLE counts identified candidates and their eligibility, not a verified complete census of all real delivery locations
counting_semantics.residential_units: site-level housing-unit attribute; it does not expand the site into multiple customer nodes

customer: one latent customer per identified residential complex or independent residential site; multiple buildings within the same complex are members, not additional customers

historical_upstream_reference.verification_scope: upstream production reference; not a full regeneration from this new repository

independent_residence: a standalone residence outside an identified complex remains its own site; a generic residential neighbourhood is not automatically one customer

inference_standard.precision_not_required: verified doorstep or entrance positions, exact parcel boundaries and exact household counts are not prerequisites for a potential customer location
inference_standard.residential_status: use a common, source-supported inference from Microsoft, NSI and OSM across all cities; residential status and complex membership are modeled evidence, not cadastral ground truth
inference_standard.uncertainty: retain source references and unresolved status where evidence is insufficient; missing unit estimates or fine residential-type disagreement alone do not invalidate otherwise supported residential locations

membership.building_footprints: retain Microsoft and OSM geometry references in source provenance for membership checks; no building count or area-based scale attribute is required; a Microsoft footprint is not itself a verified complex boundary
membership.overlapping_site_boundaries: resolve duplicate and parent/member identities before assigning records; unresolved competing sites remain explicitly ambiguous
membership.source_record_owner: each deduplicated NSI fd_id has at most one canonical site owner within a city snapshot
membership.spatial_rule: where a source-supported site extent is available, ordinary-residential NSI evidence may be associated when it covers the source point, including roof edges, courtyards and other open space within the site; a verified parcel boundary is not required

previous_audit: the 220-case review describes building-level aggregation under v2; a multi-building M verdict is not automatically an error under v3 and requires site-identity review; previous counts and weighted estimates are not site-level error rates

representative_point_and_access.access_interpretation: the connector is a modeled routing access proxy; it does not certify a physical gate, a barrier-free path or site access permission
representative_point_and_access.current_projection_implementation: Nearest diagnostic physical road first; soft building/connectivity failures may check up to 8 strict-permission local ways under local_road_access_contract_v2. Preserve the representative point, source geometry, directed offsets and real ingress/egress ledgers.
representative_point_and_access.interpretation: one complex per customer is a benchmark aggregation assumption, not evidence of one real-world doorstep or mailroom stop
representative_point_and_access.multiple_entrances: retain alternatives but choose one documented canonical access per activated site; do not duplicate the customer
representative_point_and_access.representative_point: must lie within the site; need not lie on a building roof
representative_point_and_access.road_eligibility: delivery host allowlist excludes motorway, motorway_link, trunk and trunk_link; real outside-city roads may host a border site's access and connect the network. Ordinary private roads are modeled invited-delivery terminals only; no public through-routing. Explicit prohibition, sensitive sites and unsupported barriers remain excluded.
representative_point_and_access.routing_access_point: store separately; project full site geometry to local physical roads and require real directed public-SCC access; an observed real entrance is optional evidence, not a prerequisite

review_scope: Stage1 sources, identities, auxiliary nullable units and same-graph location access; acceptance requires final independently verified corpus
scale_attribute_policy: record residential_units only; do not compute building counts, building areas or site areas as customer scale attributes, activation weights or substitutes for missing residential units

site_attributes.nsi_modeled_unit_source_sum: raw source sum retained separately for provenance; not automatically a distinct-household count
site_attributes.residential_family_evidence: retain native NSI family mixture independently of site size or estimated units
site_attributes.residential_units: the sole site-scale attribute: a nullable residential-unit estimate with source, scope, confidence and aggregation status; no invented count when unavailable
site_attributes.residential_units_scope: non_overlapping_building_components or unresolved; scope is modeled evidence, not surveyed household truth
site_attributes.site_geometry: source-supported complex or independent-residence extent, with source and confidence
site_attributes.site_id: canonical customer identity, independent of source building IDs

site_boundary_evidence.additional_candidate: OSM site relation with explicit residential-complex identity and member/perimeter evidence; type=site alone is insufficient
site_boundary_evidence.coverage: report the coverage of inferred complex identities and unresolved candidates across the 11 cities using the same frozen OSM PBFs; exact real-world complex boundaries are not a prerequisite, and previous building-only extraction cannot establish site-level coverage
insufficient_alone: generic landuse=residential covering a neighbourhood or block
one Microsoft parent footprint spanning several buildings
spatial proximity, matching residential type or a road-enclosed block
a generic name shared across multiple separate sites
site_boundary_evidence.missing_boundary: retain independent residence or provisional building candidates with site_scope_unresolved; do not claim all unidentified complexes have been deduplicated
site_boundary_evidence.primary_candidate: OSM area with landuse=residential and residential=apartments, subject to geometry, identity and scope checks

source_scope_guard.supported_split: distinct OSM source building extents, component identities and complex membership/boundary must support separation
source_scope_guard.unresolved_owner_competition: preserve sources and site identities; default unavailable and operational units null

stage2_boundary.activation_demand_TW_service_time: not implemented or frozen in Stage1
stage2_boundary.location_count_intent: unique selected site IDs, not housing units or packages

status: national_source-supported_method; current acceptance via Stage1 cohort freeze certificate

unit_counting.building_components: sum only when component estimates have supported distinct and non-overlapping scope
unit_counting.location_eligibility: missing or uncertain residential units alone must not exclude an otherwise supported residential location; units are auxiliary modeled estimates for later activation and demand review
unit_counting.site_total: No independent source field currently certifies whole-complex totals; no implemented site-total branch or inferred multiplication
unit_counting.uncertain_scope_or_overlap: retain source values and uncertainty; operational unit estimate remains null until the aggregation rule is supported
